steps.narration: First find the initial value in naira. Multiply 2,000 pounds by 600 naira to get 1,200,000 naira.
Next find the new value at the higher rate. Multiply 2,000 pounds by 620 naira to get 1,240,000 naira.
Subtract the initial value from the new value. 1,240,000 minus 1,200,000 leaves an increase of 40,000 naira.
As a quick check, multiply 2,000 pounds by the 20 naira rate rise. That also gives 40,000 naira.
First find the total value of the preference shares. Multiply 5,000 shares by 20 naira each to get 100,000 naira.
Now take 8 percent of the total share value of 100,000 naira.
Eight hundredths of 100,000 is 8,000. So the annual dividend payout is 8,000 naira.
